## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- ParquetSchemaEngine.analyze
- counts columns + rows + bytes_per_row exactly
- computes type_counts per column type
- counts nullable vs required exactly
- zero rows → bytes_per_row=0 (avoid div by zero)
- rejects empty columns (zod min(1))
